newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Aalberts shares issued at NLG 57.00.
newsitem.headline: Aalberts shares issued at NLG 57.00.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank said on Friday the issue of one million shares in industrial group Aalberts Industries NV which was announced earlier today had been successfully concluded.
"The price at which the shares were offered to investors was 57.00 guilders," the bank said in a statement.
ABN AMRO added that institutional investors in the Netherlands in particular had shown a "healthy interest" in the shares. Demand outside the Netherlands was less, the bank said.
Aalberts said earlier today it would issue the shares to finance its takeover of a 90 percent stake in German metal-hardening firm Harterei Hauck.
The deal, which doubles turnover at Aalberts' European metal-hardening business to about 80 million guilders, would immediately contribute to growth of earnings per share, Aalberts said.
